sources.factual_extract: 2022 Triton Series Madrid €50,000 No-Limit Hold'em Seven-Max. Five-handed table, 23 players remaining. Blinds 10,000/20,000 with 20,000 big-blind ante. Brian Rast (hijack, 510,000, K-J suited) raised to 40,000; Phil Ivey (button, 1,160,000, Q-9 suited) called. Board K♣5♦4♥5♣7♣. sources.factual_extract: 2024 Triton Poker Super High Roller Series Montenegro $125,000 NLHE Main Event. Four players remained. Blinds 150,000/300,000, 300,000 big-blind ante. Phil Ivey in small blind held Q♠T♠ and started with 13,600,000; Mikalai Vaskaboinikau in big blind held A♠8♠ and started with 7,800,000. Ivey limped to 300,000; Vaskaboinikau checked; Ivey bet/called 400,000 flop, bet/called 1,200,000 turn, checked river, then shoved all-in over a 3,500,000 bet. Report says Vaskaboinikau called for 2,400,000; that conflicts with his 7,800,000 start stack minus posted big blind/ante and previously reported calls/bet, which yields 2,100,000 remaining after the river bet.
